continuity_scope: Square Enix English-language Steam digital product witness for CHRONO TRIGGER, copyrighted 1995/2018 and marketed as the definitive version with updated controls, graphics, sound, the Dimensional Vortex, and the Lost Sanctum. This is not a complete representation of the 1995 original, Nintendo DS/mobile releases, subsequent Steam patches, Chrono Cross, Radical Dreamers, crossover appearances, or any franchise-wide timeline.
work_or_witnesses: Square Enix Store, CHRONO TRIGGER – Digital (Steam), English product page
Square Enix, CHRONO TRIGGER Guidelines for livestreaming and posting videos/images, last updated 10 April 2025
coverage_rule: Every individually named dramatic person in the selected Square Enix Steam product page’s detailed opening Story passage: Crono, Marle, and Lucca. The page supplies no official profile for later party members, villains, rulers, or other named characters, so none are added by familiarity. Time periods, locations, dimensions, equipment, magic/Tech systems, optional party membership, dungeons, and mechanics remain dimensions/terms; player choices and endings are not inferred.
omissions: Every Chrono Trigger name absent from the selected product-page Story passage, including later party members, antagonists, rulers, and NPCs; they require a separate direct witness rather than recognition-based inclusion.
All player party selection, battle choices, Tech combinations, dungeon progress, timeline/ending outcomes, optional content, and any assumed canonical party formation.

The 1995 original, 2008 Nintendo DS, mobile, other Steam patch states, Chrono Cross, Radical Dreamers, ports/remasters/crossovers/adaptations, other localizations, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: The official product page is a sales/story introduction, not an in-game script or full cast list; pass-complete applies only to its three named opening-story figures.

The page calls its Steam release definitive and describes added Dimensional Vortex/Lost Sanctum content, but it does not provide a change log, complete version history, or evidence that all 1995/2008/2018 versions share identical text/state.
Time travel, the planet-saving objective, and the named dungeons establish setting/mechanic context only. The source gives no official ending/timeline resolution, so none is represented.
Square Enix’s current publishing guidelines require spoiler marking for major plot developments; this narrow pass avoids later-story spoilers.
evidence_basis: Official Square Enix English Steam store description/features plus Square Enix’s current CHRONO TRIGGER guidelines for copyright/spoiler boundary. No fan or secondary source is used as canonical evidence.
